system_prompt: You are a senior medicinal chemist specializing in prodrug design and ADMET optimization. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Esterification with amino acid (L-valine) to enhance solubility and enable enzymatic activation by esterases in vivo.
modifications.rationale: Adding a valine ester improves aqueous solubility and allows for cleavage by esterases, leading to targeted release of the active drug in biological environments.

modifications.description: Incorporation of a phosphate group for increased solubility and selective activation by phosphatases.
modifications.rationale: Phosphorylation enhances hydrophilicity and bioavailability while enabling activation by tissue-specific phosphatases, such as those in tumor microenvironments.

modifications.description: PEGylation to improve stability, reduce immunogenicity, and control release kinetics.
modifications.rationale: Attaching a polyethylene glycol (PEG) chain increases systemic circulation time by reducing renal clearance and immunogenicity, while maintaining the drug's activity upon release.

modifications.description: Attachment of a galactose moiety for liver-specific targeting via asialoglycoprotein receptors.
modifications.rationale: Conjugation with galactose facilitates liver-specific delivery by leveraging asialoglycoprotein receptor-mediated uptake, enhancing site-specific activation and minimizing off-target effects.

modifications.description: Addition of a self-immolative linker with pH-sensitive cleavage for tumor microenvironment activation.
modifications.rationale: Incorporating a pH-sensitive self-immolative linker allows the prodrug to preferentially activate in the acidic tumor microenvironment, reducing systemic toxicity and improving therapeutic index.
